summary: Decision 8 re-read of 40 SEC whistleblower award orders (Releases 93635-99312): rules each order restates (the $1,000,000 threshold, the 10-30% range, the $5 million presumption, the 30/90/120-day periods) are now recorded from each order that states them.

program_rules.applies_to: monetary sanctions in the Commission action (must total more than)
program_rules.quote: based on the same original information that the whistleblower voluntarily provided to the Commission, and that led the Commission to obtain monetary sanctions totaling more than $1,000,000
program_rules.notes: Stated in defining the related action: the Commission action must have obtained monetary sanctions totaling more than $1,000,000.

program_rules.applies_to: submitting Form TCR after first providing the information, or after notice of the requirement (automatic waiver of the TCR rules)
program_rules.quote: a claimant must file a TCR within 30 days of providing the Commission with the original information to be relied upon as a basis for claiming an award
program_rules.notes: The order calls Rule 21F-9(e) "newly adopted" but gives no date. The same passage also states the waiver: compliance "within 30 days of first obtaining actual or constructive notice about those requirements or 30 days from the date he/she retains counsel".

program_rules.applies_to: presumption of the statutory maximum award where the 30% maximum across covered and related actions is $5 million or less
program_rules.quote: Rule 21F-6(c) establishes a presumption of a statutory maximum award of 30% where (1) the maximum award would be $5 million or less

program_rules.applies_to: of monetary sanctions the Commission and other authorities collect, all whistleblowers in total
program_rules.quote: Rule 21F-6(c) establishes a presumption of a statutory maximum award of 30% where (1) the maximum award would be $5 million or less
program_rules.notes: Stated as the statutory maximum within the Rule 21F-6(c) presumption.
